data: Which concept model has the highest map value for α = 0.4?

The question asks which concept model has the highest map value for α = 0.4. From the caption, we know that the figure shows retrieval results of the tf.idf weighted link translations combined with different concept models. The lines in the graph represent these different concept models. 

Looking at the graph, we can see four lines representing different concept models. At α = 0.4, the line corresponding to the concept model labeled as 'α lda + (1 - α) links' is the highest among all the lines. Therefore, this concept model has the highest map value for α = 0.4.
